# Exploring the Semantic Gap in Agentic Data Systems: A Formative Study of Operationalization Failures in Analytical Workflows

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#operationalization-failures)

The five-page arXiv:2607.00828v1 preprint, submitted 1 July 2026, was separately identified but is not the full-text version reviewed.

**Reading coverage:** All six official PDF pages: Sections 1–6, study setup and selection, failure definitions and examples, BIRD follow-up analyses, implications, conclusion and all references. ## Research question

An executable SQL query can still use an unjustified threshold, proxy, temporal operator, metric or policy criterion for the user’s analytical concept.

## Method

The authors manually inspect SQL and results produced by a GPT-4o-based Blue agent. Inputs include schemas, attribute descriptions, profiling statistics and sample values, without handcrafted analytical rules. Iterative qualitative analysis assigns each failure to one dominant class: comparative grounding, roles, processes, quantitative reasoning or policy grounding.

## Evaluation

From 250 constructed finance, HR and public-safety intents, 236 executable cases are retained. Separate analyses examine 31 BIRD MiniDev financial intents and 145 challenging BIRD intents, of which 130 yield executable queries. Judgments concern whether selected analytical operations faithfully instantiate the intended concept, rather than syntax alone.

## What the results support

The authors identify 153 failures among 236 retained cases, 19 among 31 financial cases and 88 among 130 executable challenging cases. Table 1’s category percentages use the 153 failures as denominator. Comparative and process failures account for the largest reported shares.

## Limits and qualifications

One model/platform and manually judged, selected tasks do not establish a population failure rate or model-independent causes. Annotator agreement, a fully specified adjudication rubric and repeated-run uncertainty are not reported. Illustrative replacements do not uniquely determine underspecified intent. No clarification, retrieval or repair intervention is evaluated; transfer to heterogeneous multi-tool agents is explicitly a hypothesis.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

An adjacent diagnosis of missing operational context for NL2SQL. The later VSL paper reuses 124 non-policy failures from this corpus, so its intervention results are not an independent replication of this study.
